purpose: One dataclass with every experiment knob; JSON round-trip and a run name derived from non-default fields plus a hash
Registry of the five CNNs under comparison: SimpleCNN, PANNs CNN10, ResNet-18, MobileNetV2, ECAPA-TDNN, all 1-channel spectrogram in, 2 logits out
Waveform I/O, cropping, log-mel spectrogram with input normalisation, SpectrogramDataset (real) and DummyDataset (synthetic smoke data)
Project metrics: false acceptance / false rejection ratios, EER threshold sweep, accuracy and macro-F1
The single shared training loop: optimizer/scheduler from config, GPU AMP (HIP or CUDA), early stopping, best/last checkpoints, MC-dropout eval per split
Layout of runs/<member>/<topic>/<run_name>/ and reading finished runs back as RunRecord
Optional MLflow mirror of each run, active only when MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI is set
Headless entry points: iml-train (one run), iml-sweep (grid), iml-compare (table + curves), iml-export (ONNX)
runs/<member>/<topic>/<run_name>/: config.json, metrics.json, history.csv, plots, best.pt, last.pt, env.json, model.onnx; weights gitignored
MLflow server on the training box (sqlite backend, reached through an ssh tunnel) for searching and comparing runs
Production entry point: resolve a frozen model folder or run, build its pipeline, classify a recording
One folder per architecture: pipeline/operators.py (transform -> infer -> decode), transform.py, frozen config.json/best.pt/model.onnx
Per-member notebooks: comparisons/<topic>/experiments.ipynb runs fit() for several configs and compares them; main.py calls the app
pytest: config round-trip, metrics on hand-computed cases, forward/backward of all five models, data shapes, end-to-end smoke training with MLflow

data: RunRecords for iml-compare, best.pt for iml-export
